title: Announcing new themes and templates
summary: We've revamped our themes and templates to be more useful! Head to the Template Gallery to check them out.
body_markdown:
# Announcing new themes and templates


We’ve had Themes and Templates for a while, but some of the Templates had gotten stale as we added more features. We’re happy to share that we’ve updated them all, and added a bunch of beautiful new themes.


You can explore our Themes and Templates in the[Template Gallery](https://app.thorntale.com/templates) .


Let us know which Theme or Template is your favorite!


#### Ellen Hui / CEO


Ellen builds Thorntale’s backend, query systems, database connectors, and infrastructure.
